use_when.text: Use it at the bottom of every Public Website page.
Set the width to Fill so it matches the page.
Keep three columns with up to four links each.
Edit link text directly on the instance.
Keep the privacy note, so people know ownership details stay private.

dont_use_when.text: Do not use it in the Mobile App or Back Office.
Do not put the main actions here. Put them in Top Nav.
Do not change the background or text colours.
Do not add a fourth column. Group extra links into the existing ones.
Do not swap the logo to the Dark theme. Its plate breaks the alignment.

best_practice.text: Put the links people look for last, such as Privacy and Terms, in the Trust column.
Update the copyright year each year.

placement.text: Bottom of a page, below Top Nav.

pairs_with.how: Logo Theme Light, Size Medium, in the brand column above the tagline

a11y.text: Renders a <footer>; the link columns are wrapped in <nav aria-label="Footer">.
Each column heading is an <h2>, and its <ul> of links is labelled by that heading with aria-labelledby.
The Logo carries the accessible name "Lemonade Found" (Logo default) and is not linked.
Use a footer element, and wrap the link columns in a nav with aria-label="Footer".
Make each column heading a heading element (h2) so screen readers can jump between groups.
Use real links with clear text, never "Click here".
Give the logo the alt text "Lemonade Found", or link it to the home page.
White text on the brand green is 10.6:1.

gaps.detail: Footer has no variant prop in code (Footer.tsx:4-7: a single component with no properties), so there is nothing to describe.
